name: Shine out of shield
goal: Punish an attack on your shield with a frame 4 shine out of shield
why: An attack on your shield leaves its attacker in its recovery after your shield stun ends. Fox's jump out of the shield and down-B on his first frame in the air hits on frame 4 out of shield, sooner than most attacks recover: it punishes aerials that hit the shield early, tilts, smashes and dash attacks that end close.

tutorial.what: Out of shield, X or Y with the shield held jumps on frame 1; down-B on frame {J+1}, the first frame in the air, is the shine, its hitbox out at once.
tutorial.expect: Each attack is judged when the shine comes out, or at a spot dodge, a roll, a dropped shield, or frame 20 out of shield: the frame you jumped on, the frame of the shine, and whether it hit. An attack that misses your shield is not counted.

marks.1: Frame 1: shield stun over. X, the shield held
marks.J+1: Frame {J+1}: down-B, the first frame in the air. The shine hits

lessons.title: Out of shield
text: A hit on the shield freezes both fighters, then holds Fox in shield stun: every button is ignored. Frame 1 is the first frame after it. X or Y on it, the shield still held, starts the jump.
Down-B on frame {J+1}, the jump's first frame in the air, is the shine at ground level. Its hitbox is out on that frame: frame {J+1} out of shield.

marks.1: Frame 1: shield stun over. X, the shield held
marks.J+1: Frame {J+1}: down-B, the first frame in the air. The shine hits

cues.words: X or Y now, the shield held

lessons.title: What it punishes
text: The shine hits an attacker still in its attack {J+1} frames after your stun: aerials that hit the shield early, tilts, smashes and dash attacks that end close. The opponents here attack only with those.
Down on the control stick in the shield is a spot dodge, to the side a roll, and X or Y with the shield let go drops it.

kept the shield.expect: X or Y with the shield held
kept the shield.headline: Released the shield first
kept the shield.fix: Keep L or R held as you press X or Y. With the shield let go, X or Y drops it instead: Fox can jump only a frame later, and down on the control stick then is a spot dodge.

no drop dodge.expect: No spot dodge out of the shield's drop
no drop dodge.headline: Released the shield first
no drop dodge.fix: Keep L or R held as you press X or Y. With the shield let go, X or Y drops it instead of jumping, and down-B then is a spot dodge.

no spot dodge.words: down on the control stick in the shield
no spot dodge.headline: Spot dodge
no spot dodge.fix: Press X or Y first and leave the control stick in the middle. Down-B goes on frame {J+1}, once Fox is in the air; down in the shield is a spot dodge.

no roll.words: the control stick to the side in the shield
no roll.headline: Roll
no roll.fix: Keep the control stick in the middle until Fox is in the air. Left or right in the shield is a roll.

one hit.expect: Out of the shield before another hit
one hit.words: the shield was hit again before the jump
one hit.headline: Too late
one hit.fix: Press X or Y on frame 1, the first after shield stun. Waiting, the attacker can act again: its next hit on the shield holds Fox in shield stun again.

jumped.expect: A jump out of the shield
jumped.headline: No jump
jumped.fix: Press X or Y while holding the shield, as soon as shield stun is over. During the stun every button is ignored, and a press held from it does nothing: press again.

out of shield.expect: The jump out of the shield
out of shield.words: the jump did not come from the shield
out of shield.headline: Not out of shield
out of shield.fix: Hold L or R first, then press X or Y with the shield up.

jump in time.expect: X or Y within 2 frames of shield stun's end
jump in time.words: X or Y on frame {measure} out of shield; frame 1 is the first after shield stun
jump in time.headline: Late jump
jump in time.fix: Press X or Y the moment shield stun is over. Pressed during the stun it is ignored: press it again.

strict.expect: X or Y on the first frame after shield stun
strict.fix: Press X or Y on frame 1, the first frame after shield stun, not later. Pressed during the stun it is ignored.

shined.expect: A shine out of the jump
shined.headline: No shine
shined.fix: Press down-B on frame {J+1} counting X as frame 1: Fox's first frame in the air. Down-B during the jump squat is ignored.

shine in time.expect: Down-B within a frame of leaving the ground
shine in time.words: the shine came on frame {shine_after+1} of the jump; {J+1} is the first in the air
shine in time.headline: Late shine
shine in time.fix: Press down-B {J} frames after X or Y, on Fox's first frame in the air. Later, the shine comes out above the ground and after the opponent can act.

strict.expect: Down-B on the first frame in the air
strict.fix: Press down-B {J} frames after X or Y, on frame {J+1}: Fox's first frame in the air, not a frame later.

hit.words: the opponent was out of reach
hit.headline: No hit
hit.fix: The frame {J+1} shine reaches every attack this opponent makes on your shield; later, the attacker has moved or can act. Jump on frame 1 and down-B on frame {J+1}.

verdict.success: Shine out of shield on frame {shine_frame}.

parts.name: Jump out of shield
parts.teach: Hold R or L to shield, then press X or Y with the shield still held: the jump squat. Leave the control stick in the middle.

marks.10: Frame 10: X, the shield held: the jump squat

cues.words: X or Y now, the shield held

coach.note: X or Y with the shield held, the control stick in the middle: down is a spot dodge, to the side a roll.

parts.name: The shine out of shield
parts.teach: From the shield, X or Y, then down-B on frame {J+1}, Fox's first frame in the air: the shine at ground level.

cues.words: X or Y, the shield held

parts.success: Shine on frame {shine_frame} of the jump.

coach.note: Frame 1 is X. Down-B on frame {J+1}, the first in the air.

parts.name: Against an attack
parts.teach: Shield the attack. On frame 1, the first after shield stun, X or Y with the shield held; down-B on frame {J+1}. The shine hits before the attacker can act. D-pad left and right: another opponent.

marks.1: Frame 1: shield stun over. X, the shield held
marks.J+1: Frame {J+1}: down-B, the first frame in the air. The shine hits

cues.words: X or Y now, the shield held

attempt.missed: Not counted: the attack missed your shield. Hold L or R and let it hit.

mistakes.name: X with the shield let go
the shield let go, then down-B
the stick down in the shield
the stick to the side in the shield

coach.note: Frame 1 is the first frame after shield stun. X or Y on it with the shield held; down-B on frame {J+1}, Fox's first frame in the air.
